provenance.operatorDescription: Rewrites defendant, parent/guardian and organisation names with non-ASCII text.
provenance.operatorRationale: YouthDefendantMapper.js:39 builds `name` by joining firstName/middleName/lastName with a space and calling trim(). Java String.trim() strips codepoints <= U+0020 while JavaScript String.prototype.trim() strips the full Unicode whitespace set — they disagree on U+00A0, which the `nbsp-padded` variant exists to catch. Zero-width and astral-plane characters additionally probe surrogate handling, and every one of these names is a child's.

operatorDetail.why: Latin-1 supplement and precomposed forms. YouthDefendantMapper.js:39 only joins and trims, so the port must copy these strings through byte-for-byte. NOTE: normalisation-insensitive COMPARISON is a separate question and is NOT licensed by this case
